vc_sentences: Casilla 4 Certificate number: Field Explanation and Format unchanged; Query to RA added on the numbering series (client plain consecutive versus the Mercans AAAA-nnnnnn series under Format 'N').

Casilla 25 Employee identification number: Field Explanation now records that the client certifies retirement-payment payees with the Accumulated Report 'EE Citizenship Card ID' (34 of 34) and holds their split names in a source not yet received.

Casilla 33 Place where the withholding was made: Field Explanation now defines it as a withholding-agent parameter (employer setting) whose name must match the DANE code of casillas 34-35 (client: fixed 'MEDELLIN', paired with 05001); System Mapping query added.

Casilla 34 Department code: Field Explanation now derives the code as the first two digits of the five-digit DIVIPOLA code and records that the client's working table holds '05001' in both the casilla-34 and casilla-35 columns while its printed certificate shows two different values.

Casilla 35 City or municipality code: Field Explanation now derives the code as the last three digits of the five-digit DIVIPOLA code (e.g. 001 for 05001) and records that the client's working table carries '05001' in the casilla-35 position while its printed certificate shows a different value from casilla 34.

Casilla 46 Other payments: Field Explanation now records that the client certifies the retirement payments 62151 / 62152 in casilla 46 and that the placement waits for the RA answer on casilla 50; Query to RA cross-referenced.

Casilla 50 Retirement, old-age or invalidity pensions: Field Explanation now records the client's tax-year-2025 practice (62151 / 62152 payees certified in casilla 46 with casilla 50 = 0, amounts partially reconcilable to the round-1 report for 25 of 34) and that its treatment of the 62154 monthly pensioners is not evidenced; Query to RA extended and the 21140 count corrected.

Casilla 52 Total gross income: Field Explanation now requires the engine to compute casilla 52 from casillas 36-51 and to block the certificate on a mismatch, since the client's certificates show casilla 52 = 0 with casilla 46 non-zero.

Casilla 60 Withholding on labour and pension income (rounding of all amount casillas): Field Explanation and Rounding column unchanged; Query to RA added on whether the Form 220 instruction guide requires approximation to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577 rounds returns; the 220 is a certificate under ET arts. 378-379), since the client certifies whole pesos.
Casilla 78 Debts outstanding at 31 December: Field Explanation now requires the printed label to carry the tax year certified.
Payer or withholding agent name: position corrected to the line after casilla 60, as on the printed form; Field Explanation wording aligned.
